params.1273: Given by Robin, in Port Phasmatys, for completing all Medium Tasks in Morytania.
params.1292: Morytania legs 2 and a magic lamp worth 10,000XP in a skill of your choice. Robin offers 13 lots of bonemeal in exchange for bones, and 13 free buckets of slime per day. Razmire offers a daily choice of free planks.
params.1274: The legs gain the following additional benefits:
params.1275: - Ability to teleport to the slime pit under the Ectofuntus 5 times daily.
params.1276: - Cannonball-smithing time is halved in Port Phasmatys.
params.1277: - The mushroom patch near Canifis will no longer become diseased.
params.1278: - Haunted tools will no longer attack you in the Abandoned Mine.
